mapper.sql: id, question_id, code_runner_config_id, attempt_id, student_id, source_code, idempotency_key, submission_mode, status, verdict, score, max_score, created_at, completed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edu.code_submissions WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.code_submissions (id, question_id, code_runner_config_id, attempt_id, student_id, source_code, idempotency_key, submission_mode, status, verdict, score, max_score, created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{questionId},#{configId},#{attemptId},#{studentId},#{sourceCode},#{idempotencyKey}, #{mode, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler},#{verdict},#{score},#{maxScore},NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.code_submissions SET status=#{status}, verdict=#{verdict}, score=#{score}, completed_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{submissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.code_submission_test_results (id, submission_id, test_case_id, execution_status, verdict, points_earned, time_ms, memory_kb, diagnostic, engine_submission_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{submissionId},#{testCaseId},#{executionStatus},#{verdict},#{pointsEarned}, #{timeMs},#{memoryKb},#{diagnostic},#{engineSubmissionId},NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.submission_id,r.test_case_id,t.external_test_id,t.visibility,r.execution_status, r.verdict,r.points_earned,r.time_ms,r.memory_kb,r.diagnostic,r.engine_submission_id FROM edu.code_submission_test_results r JOIN edu.code_runner_test_cases t ON t.id=r.test_case_id WHERE r.submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY t.ordinal
